events.title: CAC 40 Modestly Higher As Stocks Pare Early Losses
events.description: French stocks recovered after a weak start on Tuesday with investors reacting to some corporate earnings updates and looking ahead to the monetary policy announcements from major central banks, including the Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank this week.

events.title: German Stocks Mixed As Fed, ECB Decisions Approach
events.description: Germany's benchmark DAX declined marginally Tuesday with mixed stock performance as major central banks prepare policy announcements. Beiersdorf shares fell 4.4% after third-quarter sales missed expectations, while Porsche gained 2% on strong profit.

events.title: French Consumer Sentiment Weakest Since 2013
events.description: French consumer confidence declined to its lowest level in more than 13 years in October mid bond selloffs and expanding protests, signalling pressure on spending, survey results published by the statistical office INSEE showed Tuesday. The consumer confidence index fell to 80 in October from 85 in September.

events.title: Indian Shares End Choppy Session Little Changed
events.description: Indian shares fluctuated before ending on a flat note on Tuesday as elevated oil prices fueled inflation and rate hike concerns ahead of this week's Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

events.title: Gold Dips Below $4,000 Ahead Of Fed Decision
events.description: Gold prices dipped below $4,000 an ounce on Tuesday as elevated oil prices fueled inflation concerns ahead of this week's Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

events.title: Oil Prices Edge Up In Choppy Trade
events.description: Oil prices edged up slightly on Tuesday after falling in the previous session amid renewed diplomatic efforts to prevent a wider escalation of the U.S.-Iran conflict.

events.title: European Shares Edge Lower As French Students Vow More Protests
events.description: European stocks were moving lower on Tuesday as British banking giant HSBC posted disappointing earnings and French student leaders vowed to carry out further protests despite government concessions on education aimed at easing mounting unrest.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed Before Tech Earnings, Fed Decision
events.description: Asian stocks turned in a mixed performance on Tuesday as investors awaited earnings from major U.S. technology companies and the outcome of a slew of central bank meetings this week for direction.

events.title: Novartis Q3 Profit Declines; Lifts FY26 Core Income View, Backs Sales Outlook
events.description: Swiss drug major Novartis AG (NVS, NOVN.SW) reported Tuesday sharply lower profit in its third quarter, mainly hurt by an impairment charge and higher expenses, despite growth in net sales. Further, the firm raised fiscal 2026 outlook for core operating income and confirmed sales growth view.

events.title: European Shares Seen Tad Lower Ahead Of Tech Earnings, Rate Decisions
events.description: European stocks are seen opening a tad lower on Tuesday as investors await earnings from major U.S. technology companies and the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision for direction.

events.title: Indian Shares Marginally Lower In Early Trade; IT Stocks Underperform
events.description: Indian shares were moving lower in early trade on Tuesday as investors awaited earnings from major U.S. technology companies and the Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision for direction.

events.title: Australian Market Swings To Modest Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is swinging to modest gains in mid-market trading on Tuesday, extending the slight gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving above the 8,700 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining and financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian stock markets are mixed on Tuesday, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, amid easing crude oil prices on optimism over the resolution of the Middle East conflict following reports of a delegation from Qatar has visited Iran to discuss de-escalation of regional conflicts. Some traders also looked to pick up stocks at relatively reduced levels after the recent slump.
